Owen is interested in drawing. Life is full of small surprises. Tom learned a lot about science. In fact, the clever fox escaped from the trap.
They took many photos at the school gate. Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Tom wants to be a nurse in the future. The baby sleeps in a small cot.
The weather was windy that day. Both of them like dumplings and juice. Tom thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. What's more, reading expands your vocabulary.
The classroom is one of the best places in the city. Tom bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. Owen's birthday is in June.
